items.title: FOXA Q2 Deep Dive: Live Events and Digital Growth Drive Outperformance
items.summary: Cable news and media network Fox (NASDAQ:FOXA) announced better-than-expected revenue in Q2 CY2026, with sales up 28.1% year on year to $4.21 billion. Its non-GAAP profit of $1.79 per share was 29.3% above analysts’ consensus estimates.
